title: Module Dispatcher Input
description: Input to the Module Dispatcher for orchestrating specialist module invocations

modules.description: List of module names to dispatch (e.g., ['brand', 'builder'])

venture_context.description: Venture data to pass to modules

module_inputs.description: Input data for each module (e.g., outputs from prior modules)

parallelization_allowed.description: Whether modules can execute in parallel (set by lifecycle manager)

retry_attempt.description: If this is a retry, which attempt number (1-based)

previous_batch_id.description: For retries, reference to previous dispatch batch
